# HotCode options

<!-- GENERATED by tests/ArcaneCore.World.Tests/Docs (ConfigReferenceRenderer.RenderByArea) from the options classes. Do not edit by hand.
     Regenerate: ARCANECORE_UPDATE_DOCS=1 dotnet test tests/ArcaneCore.World.Tests --filter Docs -->

8 options. Set them in the daemon's `.conf` file or `appsettings.json`. Full reference: [configuration.md](../configuration.md). All areas: [index](README.md).

Daemon says which server reads it. Reload says whether `.reload config` applies it: `live` is applied to the running server, `restart` keeps its value until the next start, `start` is read once when the daemon starts.

## `World:HotCode`

| Option | Type | Default | Allowed | Daemon | Reload | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AuditLogPath` | `string` | `""` | text | World | start | Append-only text file that receives one line per hot-code decision (start allowed, start refused, refresh applied or rejected). Empty means no file. Not tamper-proof. |
| `Enabled` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | World | start | Allow the process to take method-body edits while it runs (the `dotnet watch` runner, scripts/hot-runner.ps1). When false the server refuses to start if the runtime is already set up for metadata updates, because the watch agent cannot be vetoed later. |
| `MaxConsecutiveFaults` | `int` | `50` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | World | start | With hot code enabled, a map updater that throws in this many consecutive ticks is skipped until the next applied code edit (the edit may be the fix) instead of failing and logging every tick. 0 disables the breaker. Ignored when `Enabled` is false, and an explicit `World:MaxConsecutiveUpdaterFaults` takes precedence. |
| `Modules:AllowAnyEnvironment` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | World | start | Modules are accepted in the Development and Staging environments only, unless this is set. Setting it is the operator saying that code may be loaded into this (deployed) instance. |
| `Modules:Allowlist` | `string` | `""` | text | World | start | Path of a text file of SHA-256 hashes (hex, one per line, `#` comments) of the module dlls that may be loaded. Empty adds no restriction (any dll in `Directory` can be loaded by an Administrator). When set it is fail-closed: a missing, unreadable or malformed file, or a dll whose hash is not listed, refuses the load and is audited. Read on every load, so editing it needs no restart. Required when `AllowAnyEnvironment` lets modules into a Production instance. |
| `Modules:Directory` | `string` | `""` | text | World | start | Folder holding one subfolder per module: `&lt;Directory&gt;/&lt;name&gt;/&lt;name&gt;.dll` plus any private dependencies. Required when `Enabled` (the server refuses to start without it). |
| `Modules:Enabled` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | World | start | Allow modules to be loaded. When false no module host exists at all. |
| `Modules:LoadOnStart` | `List<string>` | `[]` | a list: numbered keys 0, 1, 2, ...; each value is text | World | start | Module names to load once the world is running (asynchronously; a failure is logged, not fatal). |
